# Overview {.unnumbered}

This book collects two connected pieces of work on affine Toda field theory.

- **Part I, Foundations.** *Affine Toda field theories as quantum field theories: a review, a critique, and a foundation.* It reviews the field, lists twelve gaps between what is used in practice and what has been established, and closes as many as possible ([start here](foundations/01-introduction.qmd)).
- **Part II, Soliton S-matrices.** *Exact S-matrices for affine Toda solitons: $c_n^{(1)}$, $a_{2n-1}^{(2)}$ and $e_6^{(2)}$.* It constructs the soliton S-matrices that Part I identifies as missing from the literature ([start here](smatrices/01-introduction.qmd)).

Supporting code: [soliton_rmatrix_code](https://github.com/gustavdelius/affine_toda/tree/main/soliton_rmatrix_code).
